$comment: SATE design tokens — the single source of truth.
These are NOT invented. Every value was measured from what react_app_sate-ui_update
actually renders (185 files scanned), not from what its config files claim. Where the
two disagreed, the rendered value won — see README.md 'Measured, not declared'.
Consumers: sate.css (drop-in), tailwind.preset.js (React apps), verify.mjs (drift check).
Change a value here, then re-run verify.mjs in every consuming project.

primary.note: blue-600 — 174 uses. The button, the active tab, the link.

primarySoft.note: blue-50 — tinted background for info states.

sunken.note: gray-50 — 134 uses. Table headers, code blocks, hover.

default.note: gray-200 — 208 uses. Cards, dividers, table rules.

strong.note: gray-300 — 86 uses. Inputs and anything interactive.

muted.note: gray-600 — 294 uses, the most-used text colour. Labels, captions.

info.note: same as brand primary — info is not a separate hue

$annotationComment: The clinical annotation palette from index.css. These are SEMANTIC: a pause is this
blue everywhere in the product, on every surface, forever. Never reassign one, and
never use one decoratively — a user reads colour here as meaning.
`dot` is the marker/underline colour; `bg` is the transcript highlight behind the word.

fontFamily.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Oxygen, Ubuntu, Cantarell, 'Fira Sans', 'Droid Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif
fontFamily.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

$scaleComment: tailwind.config.js maps every fontSize utility to var(--text-*) — and NOTHING defines
those variables, so .text-sm etc. currently emit an invalid declaration and change no
size at all. These values restore the intended scale; sate.css defines the variables.
See README.md 'The type scale is broken in the app'.

body.note: The app's dense default. 15-16px for prose-heavy pages.

lg.note: 0.5rem — the default. 274 uses; reach for this first.

space.$comment: 4px base grid. Component padding is 'md' for compact rows, 'lg' for cards.

motion.$comment: The app animates almost nothing. Keep it that way: hover/focus only.
